# Donor Stewardship Workflow Templates

## 1. NEW DONOR WELCOME SEQUENCE

### Timeline: First 90 Days

| Timeframe | Action | Owner | Channel |
|-----------|--------|-------|---------|
| Within 24 hours | Automated thank-you email | System | Email |
| Day 2-3 | Personal thank-you call | Development Officer | Phone |
| Day 7 | Welcome packet mailed | Admin | Mail |
| Day 14 | Impact story email | Marketing | Email |
| Day 30 | Survey: "Why did you give?" | Development | Email |
| Day 60 | Program update newsletter | Communications | Email |
| Day 90 | Personal check-in call | Development Officer | Phone |

---

## 2. ANNUAL DONOR STEWARDSHIP CYCLE

### Major Donors ($10,000+)

**Q1: January-March**
- [ ] Send annual impact report
- [ ] Schedule in-person meeting
- [ ] Invite to exclusive briefing/event
- [ ] Update on funded project

**Q2: April-June**
- [ ] Personal phone call (non-ask)
- [ ] Share relevant news/article
- [ ] Site visit invitation
- [ ] Mid-year impact update

**Q3: July-September**
- [ ] Summer gratitude postcard
- [ ] Program milestone celebration
- [ ] Introduce to program staff
- [ ] Solicit feedback on direction

**Q4: October-December**
- [ ] Renewal solicitation meeting
- [ ] Holiday card (handwritten note)
- [ ] Year-end tax letter
- [ ] Invitation to annual event

### Mid-Level Donors ($1,000-$9,999)

- Monthly: Newsletter with donor spotlight
- Quarterly: Impact emails with metrics
- Bi-annually: Personal email from ED
- Annually: Thank-you call + renewal letter

### General Donors (Under $1,000)

- Immediately: Automated thank-you
- Monthly: E-newsletter
- Quarterly: Impact postcard
- Annually: Year-end appeal + tax receipt

---

## 3. MONTHLY DONOR STEWARDSHIP

### Onboarding (Month 1)
- [ ] Welcome email series (Days 1, 7, 14)
- [ ] Send sustainer welcome kit
- [ ] Add to exclusive Facebook group
- [ ] Assign to portfolio manager

### Ongoing Monthly Touchpoints
- [ ] Exclusive monthly impact email
- [ ] Quarterly "insider" phone updates
- [ ] Anniversary month: Personal thank-you
- [ ] Birthday acknowledgment (if known)

### Retention Checkpoints
- Month 3: Confirmation email
- Month 6: Special recognition + swag
- Month 12: Anniversary impact report
- Every 6 months: Personal outreach

---

## 4. LAPSED DONOR RE-ENGAGEMENT

### 0-6 Months Lapsed
**Week 1:** "We miss you" email
**Week 3:** Phone call to check in
**Week 6:** Special impact story
**Month 3:** Different appeal/project
**Month 6:** Survey: "What can we do better?"

### 6-18 Months Lapsed
- Segment by previous giving level
- Send quarterly impact updates (no ask)
- Invite to low-barrier event
- Personal note from board member
- Re-engagement campaign at month 12

### 18+ Months Lapsed
- Annual newsletter only
- Major milestone announcements
- Every 2 years: "We'd love to reconnect" campaign

---

## 5. UPGRADE PATHWAY WORKFLOW

### Objective: Move $100 donor to $500

**Month 0 (Current gift)**
- Thank-you with impact of $100 gift
- Add to mid-level email series

**Month 3**
- Share story: "What $500 accomplishes"
- Invite to virtual program tour

**Month 6**
- Personal call discussing their interests
- Ask about capacity for increased support

**Month 9**
- Invitation to exclusive event
- Introduce matching gift opportunity

**Month 12**
- Targeted $500 ask with specific project
- Offer quarterly reporting if upgraded

---

## 6. EVENT-BASED STEWARDSHIP

### Pre-Event (4-6 weeks out)
- [ ] Personalized invitation
- [ ] Follow-up call to high-value attendees
- [ ] Send event details + parking info
- [ ] Reminder email 1 week before

### During Event
- [ ] Personal greeting by board/staff
- [ ] Facilitate meaningful connections
- [ ] Collect contact preferences
- [ ] Photo opportunities

### Post-Event (Within 1 week)
- [ ] Thank-you email with photos
- [ ] Personal follow-up calls
- [ ] Survey feedback request
- [ ] Mail recap with impact metrics

### Follow-Up (2-4 weeks)
- [ ] Share outcomes/funds raised
- [ ] Schedule 1-on-1 meetings with prospects
- [ ] Send promised materials
- [ ] Add to appropriate stewardship track

---

## 7. GRANT STEWARDSHIP WORKFLOW

### Foundation/Corporate Grants

**Upon Award:**
- Thank-you letter within 48 hours
- Press release (if approved)
- Add to grants calendar
- Assign program liaison

**Quarterly:**
- Progress update email
- Financial tracking check
- Flag any concerns early
- Share relevant success stories

**Mid-Point:**
- Detailed progress report
- Site visit invitation
- Impact photos/videos
- Check on reporting requirements

**Final Report:**
- Submit 2 weeks before deadline
- Include compelling stories + data
- Request feedback on report
- Discuss future funding

**Ongoing:**
- Invite to relevant events
- Share annual report
- Include in press mentions
- Maintain relationship beyond grant

---

## 8. CORPORATE PARTNERSHIP STEWARDSHIP

### Employee Engagement Focus

**Quarterly Touchpoints:**
- [ ] Volunteer opportunity coordination
- [ ] Employee newsletter feature
- [ ] Impact metrics dashboard
- [ ] Leadership briefing

**Annual Activities:**
- [ ] Volunteer day planning
- [ ] Matching gift promotion
- [ ] Executive site visit
- [ ] Partnership impact report
- [ ] Renewal conversation (Month 10)

**Recognition:**
- Logo on website/materials
- Social media features (monthly)
- Annual report acknowledgment
- Awards/certificates for milestones

---

## 9. PLANNED GIVING STEWARDSHIP

### Legacy Society Members

**Welcome:**
- Personal meeting with ED
- Legacy Society certificate
- Recognition options discussion
- Biography/intention form

**Ongoing (Quarterly):**
- Exclusive newsletter
- Estate planning updates
- Legacy impact stories
- Invitation to annual luncheon

**Annual:**
- Personal thank-you call
- Recognition in annual report
- Update on organization's future plans
- Check if gift documentation needs updating

---

## 10. CRISIS/SPECIAL APPEAL STEWARDSHIP

### Emergency Campaign Donors

**Immediate (Within 48 hours):**
- Urgent thank-you email
- Social media acknowledgment
- Real-time update on response

**Week 1:**
- Personal call to major donors
- Impact photos/stories
- Media coverage shares

**Week 2-4:**
- Detailed impact report
- Financial transparency update
- Transition to ongoing support messaging

**Month 3:**
- Final outcomes report
- Thank-you video
- Move to regular stewardship track

---

## AUTOMATION CHECKLIST

### Set Up These Automated Workflows:

✅ **Immediate receipt** (within minutes of gift)
✅ **24-hour thank-you email** (personalized by gift size)
✅ **7-day welcome series** (for first-time donors)
✅ **Monthly donor anniversary** emails
✅ **Birthday wishes** (when data available)
✅ **Donation milestone** recognition (total giving)
✅ **Lapsed donor triggers** (6, 12, 18 months)
✅ **Year-end tax receipts**
✅ **Upgrade opportunity flags** (based on engagement)

---

## KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Track these metrics for each workflow:

- Donor retention rate by segment
- Time to thank-you acknowledgment
- Touch points per donor per year
- Upgrade conversion rate
- Lapsed donor recovery rate
- Donor satisfaction scores
- Lifetime value trends

---

**Remember:** Stewardship is about building relationships, not just processing transactions. Customize these templates to reflect your organization's voice and your donors' preferences.
